text: Explore sample notes, personal workspaces, and a cited Ask Noted answer on the welcome screen.
The note library takes up less space above your notes, and Profile has shortcuts to editing your profile, workspaces, saved decks, and Settings.
Improved contrast for note details, favorite stars, errors, and controls. Improved large-text layouts, screen reader labels, and tap targets.
HTML exports preserve continuous numbered lists and label checklist items.
